Hail Shortens a Roof.
A Tree Racks a House.
You always have final say on any settlement
Hail can take years off a roof's life. We've seen a roof rated for 30 years reduced to 15. That lost life is the case for a new roof. A patch doesn't give it back.

A tree strike causes immediate lateral shear. The load travels through the home's diaphragms and shear walls, all the way to the foundation. So we check what a quick walk through skips. Framing connections, racked walls, cracks in the foundation.
Wind lifts shingles and breaks the seal.
The leak often shows up months later. We document uplift before it's called wear and tear.
Snow load collapse gets the same structural review.
Call Before the Carrier Sets the Narrative.
Your insurance company has an adjuster protecting their interests. You have the right to one too.
Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Pacific
